items.evidence: examen leverage play <runs>/large-engine-1 --ticks 1 --settings s0 printed one JSON object with screen title and all keys tick, screen, menu_index, language, volume, difficulty, texts, score, best, coins, wave, gate_health, guard_y, quick, heavy, saved, enemies, bolts. The README command (path .../work) also works.
play --ticks 150 --inputs 0:enter,1:down+shoot --frame f1.png --size 800x480 wrote a PNG; file reports 800 x 480 RGBA.
Fresh settings folder: texts [Hold the gate: the long night, Best: 0, Start, Settings, Quit], no Continue; 0:enter gives screen play, wave 1, score 0, coins 0, gate_health 10.

One run in Settings: volume 8 to 10 stays 10 on more Right, down to 0 stays 0; language en to es to fr, stays fr on Right, Left back to es; difficulty normal by default, Right to hard and stays, Left to normal, easy, stays easy.

In es and fr I saw title, settings, play HUD, shop, pause (En pausa/Seguir/Titulo; En pause/Reprendre/Titre), lost and won (a full 8-wave run) texts. All are translated except the game name. The Spanish 'Enter: titulo' keeps the key name.

Run 1 with --settings s2 set volume 0, es, easy, and s2/settings.json held them. Run 2 with s2 started with volume 0, language es, difficulty easy, and Start gave gate 14. A fresh folder started with en, 8, normal.
--at trace: guard_y rises 0.1 a tick (6 to 12 in 60 ticks) and stays at 12 while up is held. It falls 0.1 a tick and stays at 0; x is fixed at 2.
Shoot held from tick 1: bolts appear at ticks 2, 26, 50, ... 122 (every 24). x grows 0.2333 a tick (14 u/s); a bolt at 19.97 is gone the next tick.
seed 1: walkers enter at x=20 at ticks 1, 91, 181, 271, 361 (5 in all), lanes 4, 10, 6, 2, 6, health 2, x falls 0.025 a tick (1.5 u/s).

Bolt at y 3.9 reaching walker at y 4: health 2 to 1 and that bolt is removed; the second hit removes the walker, score +10, coins +1. Bolts at y 4.7 (0.7 off) passed the y 4 walker, whose health stayed 2.
Walker at x 0.025 is gone next tick, gate 10 to 9, score and coins stay 0. Passive into wave 2: gate reached 0, screen lost, texts [You lost, Score: 0, Best: 0, Enter: title].
Settings easy then Start gives gate_health 14 (Puerta: 14); settings hard then Start gives gate_health 7.

The shop opened on the tick the last wave 1 walker went. Texts [Shop, Coins: 0/5, Next: wave 2 of 8, Quick hands ... costs 5, Heavy bolts ... costs 12, Mason: gate 5 of 10, costs 4, Next wave]. Enemies and bolts are empty, and guard_y stays 6 with up held.
Bought Quick hands (coins 5 to 0, quick 1): bolts at 531, 549, 567 (18). Level 2 cost 10 (coins 16 to 6); bolts at 3321, 3333, 3345 (12). Enter on Quick at level 2 left coins 18 and quick 2.
Heavy bought for 12 (17 to 5, heavy 1). In wave 4 each walker died to one bolt (one-tick shoot holds), wave score +80 for 8 walkers. Enter on Heavy again left coins 18, heavy 1.
Gate 7/10, coins 13: Mason gives 10, coins 9; Enter again changes nothing. Gate 6, coins 12: 9 and 8, then 10 (capped) and 4, then no change. Gate 5 with 0 coins: no change.
Next wave entered at 527: play from 528, first walker at x=20 at tick 589 (60 ticks of play). HUD 'Wave 2 of 8'. Wave 2 gave +70 points and +7 coins with every enemy killed, so 7 walkers.
Wave 3 trace: 6 walkers then 4 runners, one every 72 ticks. Runners have health 1 and x falls 0.05 a tick (3 u/s). Wave 3 total +120 points, +10 coins (6x10 + 4x15).
Wave 4: 8 walkers then 1 brute (health 6, x falls 1/60 a tick). Killing it gave +40 points and +3 coins (wave tally 120 / 11). An unshot brute reaching x 0 took gate 10 to 7.
modules/work/waves.json holds walkers/runners/brutes/every for each of 8 waves; lib.rs reads it (include_str). README section 'Changing a wave' says how.
A planned 8-wave run (seed 1, normal) ended screen won at tick 6339, score 1540 = 1340 points + 20x10 gate. Texts [You won, Score: 1,540, Best: 1,540, Enter: title]. Enter gave screen title.

Escape freezes play (enemy x frozen 50 ticks), shows Paused/Resume/Title, and Resume continues from the same x. But the reported screen stays 'play', never 'paused'. After Title the texts are a title menu while screen stays 'play' with the old enemies listed; Enter there starts a new run at once.
saved became true when the shop opened. But a later run with the same --settings folder (sP) showed saved false and no Continue: the saved run is not kept between processes (README admits this).

Within one run (no later run can see a save): bought Quick, went on, paused, Title, then Continue. The shop reopened at wave 1, score 50, coins 0, gate 10, quick 1. Next wave played wave 2 (Wave 2 of 8, first walker 60 ticks later).
Within one process: Title from the pause left saved true with Continue on the title. Start set saved false; pausing to Title then showed no Continue. Lost and won runs ended with saved false.
Won run: best 1540 on the won screen and the title ('Best: 1,540') in the same run. A later run with the same settings folder (sW) shows Best: 0: the best score is not kept between processes.
Two seed-7 runs of the same 700-tick script, each from its own copy of the same settings.json, printed byte-identical output. Wave 1 lanes are seed 1: 4,10,6,2,6 and seed 7: 6,10,6,10,8.

Frame play8.png (wave 8): gate bar at the left, blue guard at y 9.2, red walkers, green runner bars, large purple brute at x 19.45, yellow bolts, all where the state put them. HUD shows Score 960, Coins 51, Wave 8 of 8, Gate 6.
Frames: title in French with Reglages outlined (menu_index 1); settings in Spanish with Dificultad outlined (index 2); shop in French with Macon outlined (index 2); won in French.
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json hold the same keys; the UI uses @keys. README says to add a language as assets/strings/CODE.json with the keys of en.json and a name.
README has how to play, the play and frame commands (both ran as written), and where things are kept (settings.json in the --settings folder; best and saved only in memory, stated openly).

defects: The best score and the saved run are not kept between game processes at all, as README admits; only volume, language and difficulty are.
The report's screen never becomes 'paused'. After the pause's Title it stays 'play' with stale enemies while the engine's own title is shown.
Escape in the shop opens the pause menu (reported screen shop, texts Paused/Resume/Title); the brief says Escape does nothing there.
Buying Heavy bolts moves the shop's menu focus back to Quick hands, so a following Down/Enter lands on the wrong entry.
Without a saved run, Start on the title shown after pause-Title begins a run at once, without going through the game's own title state.
